item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00369","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C01","C25","C06"],"selected_candidate_label":"C01","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C01 is a direct and material drafting template for the child letter. The documents share the same purpose, recipient role, paragraph sequence, and unusually specific language concerning periodic independent evaluations, comprehensive review of foreign-intelligence activities, special attention to key intelligence elements, advice on overall progress, intelligence essential to policymaking in national security and foreign relations, an initial meeting to define the work's scope, and service as a contribution to the national interest. C25 and C06 concern the same board machinery but do not reproduce the child's letter form and language nearly as closely.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I am establishing this Board for the purpose of providing me periodically with independent evaluations of the objectives and conduct of U.S. foreign intelligence activities and of the performance of the several agencies engaged in foreign intelligence and related efforts.","parent_excerpt":"I am establishing a Board of Consultants on foreign intelligence activities of this Government for the purpose of providing me periodically with independent evaluations of the work of the organizations involved.","explanation":"Distinctive near-verbatim statement establishing the board and defining its evaluative purpose."},{"child_excerpt":"It is my desire that the Board should meet periodically to analyze objectively the work of the Government's foreign intelligence agencies.","parent_excerpt":"It is my desire that this Board should meet not less often than once every six months to analyze carefully the work of the Government's foreign intelligence activities.","explanation":"Same operative instruction, with only modest revisions to frequency and evaluative wording."},{"child_excerpt":"While the review by the Board will be concerned with all U.S. foreign intelligence activities, I would expect particular attention to be devoted to the performance of those civilian and military intelligence elements of key importance to the Government","parent_excerpt":"While the review by your group would be concerned with all Government foreign intelligence activities, I would expect particular detailed attention to be concentrated on the work of the Central Intelligence Agency and of those intelligence elements of key importance in other departments and agencies.","explanation":"Same sentence structure and comprehensive-review/special-attention distinction, adapted to describe civilian and military elements."},{"child_excerpt":"I am especially anxious to obtain the Board's views as to the over-all conduct and progress of the foreign intelligence effort as well as its advice as to any modifications therein which would enhance the acquisition of intelligence essential to the policy making branches of the Government in the areas of national security and foreign relations.","parent_excerpt":"I am particularly anxious to obtain your views as to the over-all progress that is being made... It is my sincere conviction that prompt and accurate intelligence is essential to the policy making branches of the Government in the field of national security and foreign relations.","explanation":"The child combines and closely reuses two distinctive parent formulations about overall progress and intelligence essential to policymaking."},{"child_excerpt":"It is my hope that you and the others whom I have invited to serve on the Board will be able to meet with me on May 15, 1961, to discuss in detail the scope of the work which you have so generously agreed to undertake.","parent_excerpt":"It is my hope that you and the others whom I am inviting to serve will be able to meet with Mr. Allen W. Dulles, Director of Central Intelligence, and me in the near future to determine the scope of your review","explanation":"Near-verbatim meeting invitation serving the same place in the letter and the same function of defining the board's scope."},{"child_excerpt":"I know that you and your fellow Board members can make a real contribution to the national interest by your service with this body.","parent_excerpt":"By serving on the Board you can make a real contribution to the task of Government.","explanation":"Closely parallel concluding assurance about the recipient's contribution through board service."}]}
